purpose: Separate commercial connector priority from engineering evidence/pressure-test priority without creating unsupported provider support claims.
rules: Commercial priority and engineering evidence priority are separate axes.
Public technical documentation can accelerate contract pressure-testing but cannot satisfy E3 provider-authentic acceptance.
Platform reach alone cannot determine implementation order.
Existing CR-V1 broad Türkiye gate requiring a priority Ticimax/IdeaSoft connector remains unchanged.
A secondary provider may be used for normalized-contract pressure testing without becoming the first commercial launch connector.
Native/marketplace substitute intensity affects differentiation but does not eliminate connector demand.

providers.public_evidence_summary: Official web-service/product/variation/store-stock/order capability and package/webhook entitlement are visible; exact auth/schema/test payload still not admitted.
providers.reason: High commercial priority/reach, but current public technical extraction is less exact than ikas/T-Soft.

providers.public_evidence_summary: Official public developer portal exists; abandoned-cart Admin API read surface is visible at E2; auth/webhook documentation surfaces exist but exact endpoint/schema details were not fully extractable in this environment.
providers.reason: Commercial launch priority remains high; public docs improved but provider-authentic mapping is still required.

providers.reach_evidence: 20,000+ active users in 2026; broader 100,000+ user metric kept separate
providers.public_evidence_summary: Official public GraphQL Admin API docs cover Product, Order, Customer, Inventory and Webhook; private apps use client_id/client_secret and documented admin GraphQL endpoint.
providers.reason: Strong reach plus the clearest current public developer surface makes it the best owner-free normalized-contract documentation pressure test.

providers.reach_evidence: Thousands of projects/brands/customers vendor-reference; no exact current count admitted
providers.public_evidence_summary: Official public REST/web-service docs expose token flow, per-method permissions, API console/demo and exact order/cart methods; stock-policy docs expose availability semantics.
providers.reason: Very strong public technical evidence and explicit inventory semantics make it valuable for owner-free contract pressure testing.

recommended_sequences.authenticated_e3_rule: Use the first genuinely available authorized test environment for safe contract validation, but CR-V1 broad Türkiye launch still requires the binding priority-connector gate; a secondary-provider E3 PASS does not silently replace that launch requirement.

next_owner_free_implication: Use ikas and T-Soft public docs to pressure-test normalized product/order/customer/inventory/webhook contracts where exact public evidence exists. Do not implement opaque fields or claim connector support.
next_owner_assisted_implication: When authorized Ticimax/IdeaSoft test access becomes actionable, execute exact E3 acceptance. If ikas/T-Soft access becomes available earlier, use it for E3 contract validation without changing launch priority by assumption.
